text:
Sam (Sales): quick sync for FinCo POC — ran a synthetic load sim this morning and need recommendations for the committed-reservation we should propose. baseline: 1k RPS peak, median seq=128 tokens, peaks to 2k for short bursts. customer asks for 95th <= 200ms and deterministic throughput for SLA. also they asked about KMS + data residency in the sec questionnaire. can we converge on reserved GPUs + autoscale policy and a short preheat plan?

Alex G. (Eng-ML): ran the sim with our quantized fp16 pipeline: `./tools/load-sim --rps 1000 --seq 128 --clients 200`
```
Average latency: 92ms
P50: 60ms
P95: 185ms
P99: 310ms
Setup: 4x A100-80GB (shared), KV cache cold
```
With 4 reserved gpus + our default autoscale we still see P99 spikes on bursts. At steady 1k RPS 4 gpus hit ~75% util. If we pin to dedicated (no multitenant) and prewarm KV cache, P95 drops ~20ms.

Jen R. (Eng-Infra): practical notes: preheat = warm KV + prefix cache. recommend preheat job: `redwood preheat --model finco-v1 --kvcache --duration 10m` before customer traffic window. Autoscale recs: min_nodes=3, target_cpu/gpu_util=70%, scale_up_threshold=80% over 30s, cool_down=120s, max_nodes=8. That lets bursts to 2k for ~5m without immediate fails.

Maria O. (Solutions): from presales/ops POV customers like deterministic bill need a reserved commit. Pricing wise, 6x reserved GPUs (dedicated) gives us a safe P95 headroom and simplifies the contract. I pulled a rough delta: 4 reserved + burst credits vs 6 reserved => monthly $delta ~ +32% for 6 reserved but reduces risk and avoids repeated burst charges. I'll attach detailed numbers to the doc. :money_with_wings:

Sam (Sales): thanks. can we make a short bullet recommendation I can put in the quote? customer wants a one‑paragraph ops runbook too.

Alex G. (Eng-ML): recommendation (one para): reserve 6x A100-80GB dedicated GPUs, preheat KV cache 10m before peak windows, set autoscale min=3 max=8 with scale-up at 80% GPU util and 2m cooldown. This configuration meets P95 <= 150ms in our sims and keeps P99 < 250ms for short bursts. If they want cost saving, fallback is 4 reserved + burst credits (monitoring & runbook needed).

Jen R. (Eng-Infra): runbook snippet (short):
- Preheat: `redwood preheat --model finco-v1 --kvcache --duration 10m` scheduled 10m before planned traffic surge.
- Autoscale policy: min=3, target_util=70%, scale_up_trigger=80%@30s, cooldown=120s, max=8.
- KV warmup: sample top-100 prefixes from production prompt set to seed cache.
- Fallback: route to smaller quantized variant (finco-v1-q4) if > 90% queue latency for > 2m.

Sam (Sales): Gina (Legal) — any blockers on data residency / KMS? FinCo requires EU-only logs + CMK in their Azure tenant.

Gina (Legal): EU-only tenancy is ok via Private (VPC) deployment + customer-managed KMS. We'll need a CRO + IAA addendum and an HSM/KMS integration checklist signed. No deal stopper but timeline + security review will add ~2 weeks. I flagged the sec questionnaire item 4.2 re: key escrow.

Maria O. (Solutions): ops question: for the preheat job we should provision a transient warm node pool to avoid affecting steady workers. Jen, can infra automate that so customer preheat doesn't evict production pods?

Jen R. (Eng-Infra): yes — create a preheat pool with label `preheat=true` and annotate schedule. preheat nodes are transient and drained after 15m. I'll draft the terraform snippet and a runbook step.

Sam (Sales): action items I have:
- include Alex's sizing recommendation in quote (reserve=6, burst to 8) — Sam
- attach monthly cost delta (Maria)
- draft 1-paragraph ops runbook + terraform snippet (Jen)
- surface KMS addendum and sec-qa timeline to customer (Gina)
- schedule internal smoke test with FinCo traffic profile tomorrow 09:00 PT (OpsBot please kick off sim)

OpsBot: starting scheduled smoke test now: `sim-job/finco-poc-1765001234` — logs: https://internal.redwood/sim/1765001234/logs

Alex G. (Eng-ML): note: when you run smoke test, use the real prompt set and include edge-case long contexts (512) — latency will increase; recommend we validate both seq=128 and seq=512.

Sam (Sales): perfect. I'll update the quote and ping FinCo with the recommended commit and the sec timeline. If anyone wants to join the smoke test tomorrow drop a +1 here. :thumbsup:
